tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor zlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dbal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ 'od gsal dbyings las khro bo'i sku/ /rnam 'gyur bde chen 'gyur med gsung / /zung 'jug brjod bral rdo rje'i thugs/ /lhag pa'i lha der rab btud nas/ /de yi phrin las mngon spyod kyi/ /las mtha' drag po'i cho ga la/ /brten nas dgra bgegs kun 'joms pa'i/ /gsal byed rin chen phreng 'di spel/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor ma'i cho gas/ pha rol gyi gnod pa zlog tshul cung zad brjod na don gsum ste/ sbyor ba rten dang yo byad bsham pa/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i tshul/ rjes drag po'i las dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs phyag dar dang / yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi rten bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du mchod gtor sman raka bsham ste/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du chos 'byung mthing nag che chung ji ltar 'tshams pa'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su rdo rje sngon po kha gdengs pa bri/ 'khor lo'i bar rnams nam mkha'i mdog tu bya/ de'i khar man ji'i steng du gtso bo'i gtor ma zur gsum pa la khro bo bcu'i gtor mas bskor ba dang / chos 'byung gi rtse mo lhor bstan pa'i ngos su shwa na ma dang / de'i lhor bdud rgyal gyi gtor ma la dar nag btsugs pa/ nub byang gi zur du sa bdag ma/ byang shar du bdag nyid ma rnams kyi gtor ma zur gsum pa la/ tshe dang yungs dkar gyi sgang bu/ skyer gtsang la sogs pas lag len bzhin brgyan pa'i mthar/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog rnams 'khor mar bshams/ gzhan yang de'i mtha' skor du ling ga che ba gcig la chung ba bcus bskor ba snod gcig tu bzhag la/

ling ga che ba'i ske la sngon dmar gyi zhags pas bcings pa'i rtse mor phur bu btags te bzhag pa dang / thun rdzas kyi yungs dkar nag lcags zangs rdo phye/ khrag thun thod par blug pa/ mda' zor dug shing gi mde'u can la hūm̐ bh+yoḥphaṭa rnams bris pa dang / rdo zor dur khrod kyi rdo la sngags gong bzhin bris pa gnyi ka dug khrag gis byugs pa/ rwa zor byed na glang ngam/ g.yag 'bras bu yod pa'i rwa g.yas kyi nang du dug khrag blug pa'i kha re ba nag pos bcad/ skyer pa'i phur pa dang / mtshon skud kyi kha bcings pa rnams 'dus byas la/ liṅga'i rgyu ni/ bag zan la rgyu byas/ rwa thug gi gcin/ lug thug gi chu/ gad pa chad pa'i sa/ phung shul gyi sa rnams la bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ ḍa ma ru/ rnga/ cha lang / bsnyen phur/ 'og tu dgos pa'i gdab phur bcu bdun/ de rnams la mthu bskyed pa'i yungs kar/ gu gul sogs bsham la/ rdo rje'i rtses mchod pa rnams la nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ 'khris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus gyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da pha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la rnga byin dbab rgyas 'bring bsdus pa skabs dang bstun pa bgyis nas/ skyabs 'gro ci rigs pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /sogs nas mtshams bcad pa/ bshags pa/ byin dbab/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa rnams bya'o/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang nyid rnal 'byor pa dang / mdun gyi gtor ma rnams gnyis su med par mos la/ ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa nas/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar brjod/ de nas e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ geṃ bh+rūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ ma hā keṃ ka la su me ru maṇ+ḍal/ zhes pa'i bar dang / bh+rūm̐ bi shud+dhe/ zhes pa dor la/ dbus su keṃ rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bh+rūm̐ las gser mdog 'khor lo brtsibs bcu pa/ /khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ /rtse mo rno dbal dgra bgegs phye mar rlog /rab tu 'bar ba me'i glog stong 'gyu/ /shin tu 'khor ba'i ngang tshul brtan zhing brjid/ /'khor lo'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /mu khyud rdo rje ra bas rnam par spras/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /zhes pa nas bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin bya/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bsrung zlog bsad gsum las/ rang gi snying khar ye shes sems dpa'i thugs khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ rang gi sems hūm̐ yig sngon po 'od 'bar ba'i klad kor gyi nang du/ bla ma zhal bzhugs pa rnams kyi mtshan yig dang po thig les brgyan pa/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su bu dang chung ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog 'og tu nor rdzas rnams yod par bsams la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ bsrung bya rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bkug nas sngar gyi gnas su 'khod/

'od zer gyis rang dang bsrung bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ rdo rje'i go cha gon par bsam pa ni lus bsrung ba/ rang gi lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i ra rnams la/ kī la ya'i sngags phreng bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros pas ngag gi nyes skyon dag par bsam pa ni ngag bsrung ba/ snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de/ rang dang rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs gnyis su med par bsam pa ni yid bsrung ba'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo bcu/ phra thabs/ sgo ma dam can rnams bskul te/ de dag las sprul pa yang sprul dang / nying sprul grangs med spros nas bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams phye mar byas shing khro bo phra thabs/ sgo ma rnam kyang zhal phyir gzigs te/ gnod pa phyir zlog pa'i las mdzad/ 'khor lo yang g.yon du 'khor bar bsam pa bzlog pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs bar rnams su yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du/ byad ma lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag bskyugs pa/ spyi bo tshugs su gnas pa re re bsam/ rang gi snying kha nas pho nya lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa mang po spros nas/ dgra bgegs gang na gnas pa'i yul nas gzugs dang / rnam shes rang dbang med par bkug ste/ rtsibs bar gyi byad ma rnams la bstim/ rang dang bsrung bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byad ma'i lus kyi bu ga dgu nas/ thim ste zhugs pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs g.yon du myur bar 'khor bas/ 'og gi rlung mes bskyod cing / rtsibs rnams ral gri'i so lta bus/ dgra bgegs kyi lus dum bu dum bur gtubs/ lhag ma pho nya rnams kyi zos/ mid/ brlag par byas par bsam pa ni bsad pa'o/ /de nas hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya/ zhes brjod pas ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra yum med pa mdun du phyung / dz+nyā na sa twa/ ces sogs kyi snying kha'i sems dpa' gsum brtsegs gsal btab nas/

ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags phreng byung ba rang gi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de las sngags phreng byung ste/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ sngags phreng phyir 'gro ba'i dus su rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med pa spros nas/ sems can thams cad kyi las ngan pa thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur par bsam/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang / nus mthu thams cad rang la thim pas/ gzi byin rgyas par bsam/ rang gi sngags zlos pa'i dus su/ khro bo phra thabs sgo ma dam can rnams dang / mdun du spyan drangs pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyi bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad de sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar grags par bsam la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags nas/ dbang phyug ma'i bh+yo'i bar du sgrub thabs bzhin bzlas pa'i mthar/ gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /ma rak+mo/ yak+mo/ kā la rū pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la khril khril/ srog la chum chum/ tsit+ta srog la tuṃ tuṃ/ thum ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shan/ snying tshag tshag 'ur 'ur/ shig shig gul gul/ nyag nyag sod sod/ dha ti/ ma ma shī gh+raṃ/ karma ka ra mā ra se na/ pra marda ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / bha ya na ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ thal mo sbyar nas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum/ phra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga/ dam can bka' bsrung bcu gnyis rnams kyi bden pa dang /

bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / zhes pa nas/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa'i bar gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /zhag sbrel nas byas na/ nub dang po rnams la 'di'i skabs su rigs 'dzin bskul la/ yi dam kye rdo rje sogs dang / chos skyong rnams la gtor ma phul nas bskang bshags dang / bstod pa ji ltar rigs pa byas nas rjes kyi cho ga la/ tshogs dang po gnyis kyi rjes su liṅga rnams gu gul gyis bdugs la rang gi mdun du bzhag rang nyid rdor dril thogs nas dgug gzhug 'og nas 'byung ba ltar lan gsum byas la/ liṅga'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang / ri rab kyis mnan te thar sa med par bsam la/ liṅga'i ske la btags pa'i phur pa gtor ma la btsugs te bzhag la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas/ so so'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer rab tu mang po 'phros te gtor ma dang thun rdzas rnams la phog pas/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu skyed la/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' mdzod cig /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /pad+ma gsung༞ yang dag thugs༞ bdud rtsi yon tan༞ phrin las phur bu༞ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis/ /'jigs byed khro bo bcu po yi/ /rdo rje khro mo bcu rnams kyi/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu yis/ /sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga yis/ /dam can shwa na bcu gnyis kyis/ /bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi yis/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /rig 'dzin rtsal can 'khor bcas kyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu skyed la/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' mdzod cig

/bdag gi gtor zor mnyan po 'di/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gros nus pa skye/ /dam can srung mas drag por bsgrubs/ /sdang byed dgra la 'phen pa'i zor/ gnod byed bgegs la 'phen pa'i zor/ /gdug can thal bar rlog pa'i zor/ /dam nyams rtsad nas gcod pa'i zor/ /dgra bo'i rigs brgyud gcod pa'i zor/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung bskyed pa'i zor/ /zor chen sogs/ dam can bka' bstod mthu ma chung / /pho nya las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /bh+yauḥsdang pa'i dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yauḥganod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥ zhes bskul nas/ gtso bo'i sngags dang / khro bo bcu/ sgo ma bzhi/ gzhi rnying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags dang / thun sngags 'di yang bzlas te/ suṃ tri ka rak+sha bh+yoḥ thib thib tsakra bh+yoḥ snying kha rag dun tri bh+yoḥ tri na shig se na gtub/ kha raka rbad/ dum bu bh+yoḥ badz+ra ra ti rak+sha tsa tur mā ra ya hūm̐/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa rnams ci rigs brjod/ mgon po'i thun gtor rnams phul nas dngos grub blangs la/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun gyi rten rnams brtan bzhugs dang / /bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /nub tha ma la tshogs bar pa yan gong bzhin byas la/ gsum pa rjes drag po'i las dngos bstan pa la yang gsum/ sngon 'gro yang 'brel so drug bya ba/ dngos gzhi gdab pa'i las byas nas ling ro 'bul ba/ zlog pa zor gyi las bstan pa'o/ /dang po la drug gser skyems gtong ba/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ lha bsrungs spyan drangs zhing dgug gzhug bya ba/ gsal ba gsum dang gdengs gsum gsal btab ste nga rgyal bskyed pa/ ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs pa/ rdzas dmod mo ting nge 'dzin sogs drug bya ba'o/ /dang po ni ji ltar bde ba'i sar mi'i g.yang gzhi bcos pa'i khar/ 'brub khung gru gsum nag po me ri dang bcas pa bris pa'i dbus su/ liṅga rnams bzhag

rang gi g.yas su gu gul/ yungs dkar nag sngon dmar gyi zhags pa/ dug khrag sbyar ba'i thun/ lcags zangs rdo phye rnams dang / g.yon du gdab phur rnams dang / ral gri tho ba/ de dag la ngar bskyed pa'i sman phud dang / rak+ta cung zad/ rdo rje dril bu rnams bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams he ru ka'i chas su zhugs la/ gser skyems gtsang ma khyer nas byin rlabs gong bzhin byas te/ 'jam po'i 'khyil 'chams dang / gu ru'i snyan dbyangs dang bcas pas/ 'di skad brjod do/ /rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / /rigs 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa dang / /snyan nas snyan brgyud bla ma mchod/ /zhi gnyis zhi ba'i lha tshogs dang / /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i tshogs/ /ma lus phud kyi mnyes gyur nas/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yi/ /nyer dgongs byin rlabs dpa' skyed las/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs dang / pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs dang / yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs dang / bdud rtsi yon tan༞ phrin las phur bu'i༞ ma mo rbod gtong༞ dmod pa drag sngags༞ 'jig rten mchod bstod༞ rdo rje tshe༞ mdo dang sgyur 'phrul lha tshogs rnams/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yi/ /sogs dang༞ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum dang / /sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu dang / /ye shes sgo ma bzhi po dang / /sras mchog phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yi/ /sogs/ dam can bka' bsrung bcu gnyis dang / /ging chen dge bsnyen 'khor bcas mchod/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dang / /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad mchod/ /pho nya phra men 'bar ma dang / /ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs mchod/ /bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi dang / /dpal ldan re ba ti la sogs/

/mdor na sum brgya drug cu rnams/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /gdug pa'i sogs dang / bstan pa bsrung mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /dpal ldan nag po lcam dral dang / /zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa/ /chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs bcas kun/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /sogs/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams dang / /gnas bdag kun dang yul bdag kun/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /byer dang 'khu ldog ma mdzad par/ /stong grogs gnyan po ci nus mdzod/ /sa yi phyogs ni 'di nyid na/ /sa'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa/ /thams cad phud kyis tshim gyur nas/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /stong grogs gnyan po ci nus mdzod/ /lha yi phyag rgya mi bzod cing / /byer dang 'khu ldog byed pa rnams/ /gser skyems gtsang mas tshim byas nas/ /ci bde ba ni gzhan du dengs/ /bsdus pa ni/ /bla ma rigs 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod/ /khyad par phur bu'i lha tshogs mchod/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yi/ /sogs/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas/ /phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho phud kyis mchod/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis 'phel bar༞ bstan pa bsrung mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /man gong bzhin no/ /gnyis pa phur kha bsgyur ba ni/ tshe 'dzin gyi 'gying dbyangs dang / rin po che'i 'dur 'chams bya zhing / do nub kyi phur kha gnyan po 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi ston no/ /lha gshegs gangs dkar rtse la gshegs/ /phur lam gnyan po da phye cig /de bzhin du tshig gong 'og rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/

bar gyi btsan la mi ston no/ /btsan gshegs brag dmar logs la gshegs/ /'og gi klu la mi ston no/ /klu gshegs rgya mtsho'i gting du gshegs/ /do nub kyi phur kha gnyan po 'di/ yas kyi bdud g.yos gcig la ston/ /mas kyi sri langs gcig la ston/ pha tshan rgya 'dre can la ston/ /ma bu'i byur 'dre can la ston/ /yul mi gdong 'dre can la ston/ /sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs la ston/ /phung sri snying gi dkyil du ston/ /byur sri klad pa'i dkyil du ston/ /nyams pa'i snying gi dkyil du ston/ /rmi lam ngan sdig byed la ston/ /gsum pa lha bsrungs spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sgrub thabs bzhin dgug gzhug lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo 'gugs pa'i stangs ka byas la/ pañca kan+dha de ba ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dha tu aṣ+ṭa da sha de wa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dwa da sha ya tā na na de wa a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sarba de wa rak+ṣa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod cing / sems kyi rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi liṅga dgra bgegs su gsal ba'i snying khar phog pas/ kho la srung skyob byed pa'i lha dang / srung ma thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam par byung ste/ rang la thim pas/ kho bsrung skyob dang bral zhing / bdag nyid gzi brjid rgyas par bsam pa ni/ tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka/ /sprul pa yang sprul bka' bstod dang / /pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs shing byin phob la/ /dam sri gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las 'da' byed cing / /rnal 'byor sku la bdo ba rnams/ /rgyal bas bsgral bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gnas pa'i yul nas yud tsam gyis/ /brten dang bcas te khrid las shog /rgyab dang khrol las khrid las shog

/sa gzhi yan chod thog las shog /bdun brgyud tshun chad khug las shog /ma thogs myur du khug las shog /oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ bzhi pa gsal ba gsum dang gdengs gsum gsal btab cing nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ bde ba'i brjid dbyangs dang / /nor bu'i bskor 'chams bya zhing / hūm̐/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /thugs nang 'bar ba'i srog kyang zhugs/ /tshigs brgyad spyi bo rkang mthil rnams/ /khro bo khro mo'i bdag nyid gnas/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /nyi khri chig stong skra tshogs dang / /bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i tshogs/ /khro rgyal rang 'dras gtams par gyur/ /khro bo khro mo phra men dang / /sgo ma sras mchog phur bu'i tshogs/ /dam can rgya tsho'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ma lus khro rgyal nyid kyi ngang / /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dip+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ /zhes pa nas gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ liṅga bsgral yul bzas pa po/ /shin tu rid cing yan lag phra/ /mi sdug bzhin can tshar bcad phyir/ /mngon sum nyid du gsal bar gyur/ /lnga pa ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs ni/ rdo rje'i 'tsher dbyangs dang / dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'chams bya zhing / rgyud gsum bla ma rigs 'dzin tshogs/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /khyad par phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra yin/ /dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra lags/ /sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe byas/ /mtshams med de dang nye ba bsags/ /nyams pa bdun dang zhing bcu tshangs/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bkrongs pa ste/ /'di de sdig pa chen po can/ /mnar med 'gro ba'i bdag nyid yin/

/bdag gi snying rje cher bskyed nas/ /'jig rten rten 'brel nor rdzas dang / /'dus byas zas kyi longs spyod byin/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi brid byas nas/ /las ngan 'di las bzlog cig ces/ /yang yang gsol yang bzlog ma nyan/ /des na gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /re shig thugs kyi btang bar 'tshal/ /bdag gi ma nyes ma g.yo zhing / /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pas/ /de ltar legs par bzung du gsol/ /chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad pa/ /phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bdag la dgongs/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /bla ma'i sku la 'khu 'khu ba/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la 'gom 'gom pa/ /rnal 'byor sku la bsdo bsdo ba/ /bdag kyang 'phags pa rab mchod cing / /gzhan don ci nus bgyid bsam pa/ /dgra bgegs 'di yis ma gter ro/ /spros bral rang bzhin dag pa'i klong / /dbyings kyi thig ler bsgom snyam pas/ /bar chad rkyen 'dis ma gter ro/ /bdag gi cung zad ma nyes shing / /rnam pa kun tu ma g.yo bas/ /de ltar mkhyen par mdzad nas kyang / /mthu stobs skyed pa'i cho ga mdzod/ /lha dang gnyis su med par bsgom/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i grogs mdzod cig /drug pa rdzas dmod mo ting nge 'dzin sogs drug bya ba la lha dang dbral ba/ gzugs la dbab pa/ byed du gzhug pa/ smyo ru gzhug pa/ rdul du rlog pa/ zhal du bstab pa'o/ de re re la drug drug ste/ bsag par bya ba'i rdzas drug bsam pa mthar phyin pa'i dmod mo drug dmigs pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin drug bskyed par bya ba'i lha drug sbas pa'i 'phyongs drug /gab pa'i sngags drug rnams las/ dang po ni/ rdzas gu gul/ gnyis pa dmod mo ni/ na mo bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /ye shes sprul pa'i khro bo bcu/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi khro mo bcu/

/thabs kyi rang bzhin mche ba can/ /shes rab rang bzhin gshog pa can/ /bdag nyid shwa na sa bdag sogs/ /phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /chos kyi srung ma dang khrol cig /bon gyi lha sa dang khrol cig /skye bo'i dgra lha dang khrol cig /pho lha yul lha srog lha dang / /bskyed pa'i lha bzhi 'go ba yi/ /lha lnga dbang thang lha drug dang / /skyob pa'i lha kun dang khrol cig /brten pa'i sa dang gnas pa'i yul/ /kun dang myur ba nyid du khrol/ /gsum pa dmigs pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ ram zla byed pa'i btson bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes brjod/ bzhi pa skyed par bya ba'i lha ni/ sgo ma sras mchog la sogs pa rnams kyi/ gu gul gyi bdug par bsam mo/ /lnga pa sbas pa'i 'phyong drug ni/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /nas/ nga yi bka' las ma 'da' cig /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /bsdigs shig grogs dang dbye bar gyis/ /drug pa gab pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mo haṃ gha ta ya gnod byed dgra bgegs ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra shī gh+raṃ karta ya/ mā ra se na pra marda ni sarba bigh+nān ban+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa la drug gi dang po rdzas yungs kar sogs dang / gnyis pa bsam pa mthar phyin pa'i dmod mo ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyi/ /dgra 'di phob cig gzugs la phob/ /ri mo la phob liṅga dang / /gnyis su med pa nyid du gyis/ /gsum pa dmigs pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bye mar char 'bab bzhin du gyur/ /bzhi pa bskyed par bya ba'i lha ni/ sras mchog sogs kyi thun thogs par bsam pa'o/ /lnga pa skul tshig ni/ dam tshig chen po sogs nas/ gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ /drug pa gab pa'i sngags ni/ thog mtha' gnyis gong bzhin la/ gnod byed dgra bgegs ā be sha ya/

ā be sha ya/ gsum pa byad du gzhug pa la/ dang po rdzas sngo dmar gyi zhags pa/ gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra 'di zungs shig rab chings shig /lus dang yan lag kun sdoms shig /gru gu bzhin du rab bsgongs shig gsum pa ni/ lcags kyis bcings pa'i btson bzhin gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ /sras mchog zhags pa thogs par bsgom/ /lnga pa ni/ /dam tshig chen po sogs nas/ gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ /drug pa ni/ gnod byed dgra bgegs shī kriṃ a na ya sogs/ bzhi pa smyo ru gzhug pa la/ /dang po rdzas dug thun/ gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra 'di smyor chug myos su chug /gsum pa ni/ dbang med smra zhing lab par gyur/ /bzhi pa ni/ sras mchog dug thun thogs par bsgom/ /lnga pa dam tshig chen po nas/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /ring nas khug las smra ru chug drug pa ni/ gnod byed dgra bgegs dz+wā la pā ya dz+wā la pā ya sogs/ lnga pa rdul du rlog pa la/ dang po ni/ lcags zangs rdo phye/ gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyi/ /dgra 'di med brlag phung bar gyis/ /gsum pa ni/ thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par gyur/ /bzhi pa ni/ sras mchog sogs lcags zangs kyi thun thogs par bsgom pa'o/ /lnga pa dam tshig chen po nas/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /lus sems rdul phran bzhin du rlog /drug pa ni/ gnod byed dgra bgegs ta thā ya sogs/ drug pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ rdzas ling ro/ gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ dgra 'di bzhes rol zhal du gsol/ /gsum pa ni/ dgra bgegs zhal du bstab par gyur/ /bzhi pa ni/ sras mchog sogs ling ro thogs pa/ lnga pa dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab nas/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /kyi bar dang / gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā hi/

drug pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mo haṃ gha ta ya gnod byed dgra bgegs bi da ya bi da ya/ shī gh+raṃ karta ya/ mā ra se na pra marda ni/ sarba bigh+nān ban+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi gdab pa'i las bstan pa la drug kun gzhi rtsad bcad de bsgral ba/ nyon mongs pa skye ba'i sgo lnga dag par bsgral ba/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag par bsgral ba/ ma bdud kyi dmod mos bsgral ba/ dge sdig cha mnyam ste bsgral ba/ gtun du brdung ste bsgral ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gong bzhin dgug gzhug lan gcig byas la/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ ces pa nas/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar brjod la/ de nas kun gzhi'i gnas lugs gsal gdab pa ni/ liṅga de/ dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba'i snying kar rtsa bzhi ni/ chos nyid rang 'byung gi rtsa/ gnyis med ye shes kyi rtsa/ glo bur rgyud 'dzin gyi rtsa/ skyon yon dbang po dwangs byed kyi rtsa bzhi bsdoms pa'i dbus su/ sha'i dwangs ma/ bye'u lan pa'i mgo tsam gyi nang du/ khrag gi dwangs ma 'tshal lcog ma lta bu/ de'i nang du rtsa'i dwangs ma dar dkar gyis skud pa lta bus dril nas dbugs kyi dwangs ma drod kyi rnam par gnas shing / de'i nang na 'od kyi dwangs ma nya'i mig tsam gyi dbus su/ tshe'i rten sdom gyi rgya lta bus dril nas rnam par shes pa a dkar po'i rnam par gnas pa ni/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi'o/ /de ltar bsam nas gtso bo'i phur pa rang gi klad la skor bas sku'i lha tshogs 'dus par bsam la/ de bzhin du mgrin pa dang / snying khar sgril bas/ gsung dang thugs kyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs par bsam/ de nas khrus lung la/ khams gsum sems can gyi khrus lung / bdag rnal 'byor pa'i khrus lung / liṅga bzas pa po'i khrus lung dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying khar a dkar po bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros/

mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas a dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ khams gsum gyi sems can la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par 'dus nas/ rang gi snying khar thim par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa bdag gi khrus lung ni/ slar yang mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ a dkar po grangs med pa byung ste/ rang gi lus gang bas nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag par bsam/ gsum pa liṅga bzas pa po'i khrus lung ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros nas/ rang gi lag tu thogs pa'i phur bu de'i dbu'i gtsug nas zhugs/ phur pa'i rtse mor a dkar po gcig tu bsam pa las/ a dkar po 'phros nas/ liṅga'i nang gang bas/ kho'i las ngan thams cad sbyangs par bsam la/ phur pa ma reg tsam du sgril/ de nas phur pa snying dkar nag gi mtshams su btab pas/ phur pa'i 'od zer gyis/ snying kha'i rtsa bzhi gur gyi chon thag bcad pa bzhin du gtubs/ sha dang khrag gi dwangs ma rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin tog gis bskam/ rtsa'i dwangs ma rnams dar lce la me bcug pa bzhin thul gyis bsregs/ dbugs dang 'od kyi dwangs ma bye tshan la chu blug pa bzhin du bcom/ /tshe'i rten la phur pa'i 'od zer phog pas/ sbrang bu me nang du song ba bzhin choms kyi bsregs te/ rnam par shes shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po bkrag dang gzi brjid thams cad phur pa'i rtse'i a de la 'dus par bsam zhing / oṃ laṃ sogs kyi sngags brjod/ slar phur pa bton nas phur mgo rang gi gnas gsum du reg la bo dhi tsit+ta oṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ kho'i tshe dang bsod nams dang bkrag mdangs thams cad rang la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam pa ni/ bdag rnal 'byor pa'i tshe lung ngo / /de nas phur pa sgril te sngar bshul du btab pas/

kho'i rnam par shes pa a dkar po de/ phur pa'i rtse la blangs nas phur rtse nam mkha' la bstan te rang gi rlung bus la/ phur pa'i dbu nas zhugs te kho'i rnam shes bya sgro rlung gi bskyod pa bzhin song nas/ 'og min du rgyal ba rigs lnga sbyor ba mdzad pa'i bar du song bas/ sangs rgyas par bsam pa ni/ liṅga'i tshe lung ngo / /phur khung la thun gsum gyis brab/ phur pa la sman rag gtor te/ ngar skyed par bsam la/ slar yang snying khar btsugs nas bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ bgegs byed pa yi bdud rnams dang / /sogs brjod cing hūm̐ mdzad/ rnam rgyal gyi phur pa thogs la hūm̐ mdzad spyi bo dang / rnam rgyal dpung pa g.yas la gdab/ de bzhin du dbyug sngon can lag pa g.yon/ gshin rje gshed dpung pa g.yon/ mi g.yo ba pus mo g.yas/ rta mgrin kha/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa pus mo g.yon/ 'khyil pa gsang gnas 'jig rten gsum rgyal lag pa g.yas/ stobs po che rkang pa'i bol gong gnyis bsnol mtshams su gdab/ de bton la bshul thun gyis brab/ sngar shul du 'debs pa sogs re re bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phra thabs kyi phur bu bzung la/ pho nya bran dang mngags pa'i tshogs/ /nas/ pra marda ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brjod la/ phra thabs rnams khro bo bcu'i g.yas g.yon du gdab/ sgo ma bzhi snying kha'i phyogs bzhir gdab/ thun gyi brabs pa sogs bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ral gri thogs pas/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' lung gis/ /nas/ wa shaṃ ku ru'i bar brjod la/ mgo dang yan lag rnams gtubs so/ /lnga pa ni/ yungs dkar nag lcags zangs rdo phye la sogs bsres pa'i thun rdzas bzung ste/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /nas/ ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brjod cing thun gyis brab bo/ /drug pa ni/ rdo rje tho ba thogs la/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar brjod la tho bas rdung tshul dang / slar yang ral gris snying kha nas lus drang por gshags la lus dum bur gtub cing /

dgra bgegs mi skyod pa'i zhing du bskyal bar bsam mo/ /ling ro 'bul ba ni/ ling ga'i dum bu ban dar bcug la stob pa'i tshul bya zhing / 'dod yon lnga bsam la/ baiḍūr sngon po'i rin chen ri rab las/ /zhes pa nas/ bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi'i zhal du btab ces dang / rgyas par/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal du kha raṃ sogs dang / 'dod chags rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil li li/ /zhe sdang rus pa'i phung po khro lo lo/ /gti mug sha'i phung po thibs se thibs/ /dug gsum bsgral ba'i mchod pa bla na med/ bla med mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /lha tshogs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sogs brjod la/ ling ro gtor ma la phul sbyin sreg dang / /mnan pa byed na/ liṅga'i khog stod gtor ma la phul/ khog smad la sbyin sreg bya zhing / mgo la mnan pa bya'o/ /de nas gsum pa rjes zlog pa zor gyi las bstan pa ni/ zor gtor rnams lhar gsal ba'i ye shes rnams nam mkhar bzhugs nas/ bdag gi drag po'i las kyi grogs mdzad/ dam tshig pa rnams 'od du zhu nas/ dug dang mtshon cha dang / me dpung du bsam la gtso bo'i sngags nas/ thun sngags kyi bar gong bzhin brjod la/ zlog pa'i tshig rnams tshar gcig gam gsum skabs dang sbyar ba zlog gzhung ltar bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyi/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu skyed la/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' mdzod cig /sogs gong bzhin brjod la/ gtor ma rnams phab ste/ sngon la bdud rgyal/ de nas shwa na ma/ sa bdag ma/ bdag nyid ma/ gtso bo'i gtor ma rnams phyir cung zad bskur la/ gnas de nyid du'am gzhan gang bder bdud rgyal gyi bskul bya ba ni/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /srog gi gshed du bskul ba ni/ /bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sku ni mthing nag chen po la/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po chibs/

/lag na lcags mdung nag po thogs/ /g.yon pa thod pa'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /thod pa skam po'i dbu la rgyan/ /mi spags rlon pa sku la gsol/ /sbrul dang rgyu mas sku la rgyan/ /khrag dang zhag gi thig le can/ /mche ba gtsigs shing gsus pa che/ /tsit+ta khrag la longs spyod pa/ /khyod ni srog bdag chen po ste/ /sring gcig rdo rje re ba ti/ /ming sring gnyis kyi dam bcas pa/ /dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas/ /dbang rtags thod pa byin nas ni/ /bka' stsal dam tshig phog pa'i tshe/ /de tshe khas blangs dam bcas nas/ /sgrub mchog skyong bar zhal bzhes shing / /dgra bgegs sgrol bar dam bcas pa/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /khyod ni srog bdag chen po ste/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' thang mdzod/ /srog dbugs longs shig sa ma ya/ khyod kyi zas skal sha yin te/ /dgra bo'i sha la hab kyis zo/ /dam nyams sha la kha raṃ khā hi/ /khyod kyi btung skal khrag yin te/ /dgra bo'i khrag la hub kyis 'thung / /'thungs shig khrag 'thung thod phreng can/ khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /sa gzhi thams cad dmag gis khongs/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs la/ /dmag sna drongs shig thod phreng can/ /gnyan po bdud kyi las yin gyis/ /dmag gzhug brtul zhig thod phreng can/ /go mtshon rdor zhig thod phreng can/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs las/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i brla mkhar bshig /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bskul rgyas par byas nas/ /gtor ma rnams rim gyi khyer la yang ji ltar 'os pa'i sar bskul chung ba 'di bya ste/ hūm̐ dpal chen bka' stod mthu bo che/ /bdud mgon nag po las la bzhengs/ /zlog pa'i dmag sna da mdzod cig /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzod/ /bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /dam can srung ma'i dmag sna drongs/

/g.yas na dregs pa pho brgyud tshogs/ /dmag la phyos shig dgra la bh+yoḥ /g.yon na dregs pa mo brgyud tshogs/ dmag la phyos shig dgra la bh+yoḥ /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /dmag la phyos shig dgra la bh+yoḥ /nga ni khrag 'thung he ru ka/ /thams cad nga yi bka' la nyon/ /phyos shog zlog pa'i dmag la phyos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis/ /ngan pa bzlog la rtsub mo bsgyur/ /mi mthun bdud bgegs bar chad rnams/ /thams cad sdang pa'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /zlog go bsgyur ro thod phreng can/ /dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /dus la bab po mthu ma chung / /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /zhes pa'i bskul byas nas/ bzlog pa'i dzam 'gros kyi gtor ma 'degs sar phyin la/ gser skyems bsdus pa btang la/ dpang gzugs gong bzhin bya'o/ /zor lam dbye ba ni/ do nub kyi zor kha gnyan po 'di/ steng gi lha la mi zor ro/ /sogs gong phur kha ston pa 'don pa bsgyur la bya/ de nas/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /sogs kyi zor bskul nas/ gtor ma sogs dug thun du bsam la dgra bo'i rnam shes mar me lta bu la phog pas/ thum thum bsad cing bsgral bar bsam la/ kī la ya dang / khro bo bcu'i sngags/ bsgral mchod kyi sngags rnams brjod cing / dang po mda' zor/ de nas bdud rgyal/ de nas shwa na ma/ sa bdag ma/ bdag nyid ma rnams kyi gtor ma rnams kyi gtor ma rnams rim pas 'phangs/ de nas khro bcu gtso gtor dang bcas pa/ de nas rwa zor/ de nas rdo zor 'phen no/ /de nas yar log la/ gtor snod kha phub pa'i mthar/ sgrub pa po rnams lag pa g.yon steng du bsnol nas g.yas g.yon gyi srin la sbrel nas hūm̐ dang po zhe sdang nyid las byung / /bar du zhe sdang nyid kyi 'khor/ tha mar zhe sdang nyid kyi 'dul/ zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyi/

/lcags sam nag po'i shing dag la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum/ /logs la drag po'i lha bsgom ste/ /khong stong byang chub sems lung bstan/ /rtse mo zur gsum btab pa yi/ /thams cad ma lus brlag par 'gyur/ /brlag par ma gyur gang yang med/ /drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ sarba bigh+nān sha trun mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya'o/ /de nas nang du log la/ tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma btang / pho nya bskul zhing / steng du gtor ma bskyangs/ bstan skyong rnams byas la lhag chad kha bskang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'os pa rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams rgyas par bya'o/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi bgrod cig lam/ /rnam mang rgyud sde rgya mtsho bsrub pa las/ /srid pa'i dbul sel dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gter/ phan bde'i 'bras stsol rdo rje theg pa mchog /gang la brten na mchog grub cing / /phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par/ /'grub byed drag po'i las gzhung gis/ /gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dpal/ /nye bar bskrun pa'i dge ba gang / /kun+da lta bur dkar ba des/ /mkha' mnyam skye dgu ma lus pa'i/ /rnam par 'dren pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa lhag pa'i lha du mas rjes su bzung zhing / dpag par dka' ba'i mkhyen rab dri ma med pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i gtor zlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs su/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba rigs sngags 'chang shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'bru mang po zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo gro zhun gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ dpal snar thang gi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rin chen shes rab kyis bgyis so/
